record.body:
## Problem

The dashboard is only useful when it is one keystroke away in the tmux session.

## Approach

Not yet scoped. Direction: a tmux popup binding that opens `watch` in the current pane's repo, an optional persistent side pane, and a one-line Claude Code status line summary. Decide at plan-phase. The phase ends with a verification task that depends on every other task in it.

## Exit criteria

Details decide at plan-phase. Gate: every acceptance has a passing check-run, and an integration test opens the popup in a detached tmux session and captures the dashboard for the pane's repo.
